text: The Marketing menu's User Content section links to All Reviews and Pending Reviews.
The All Reviews grid presents reviews in a table and supports filters for status, creation date, title, nickname, review text, visibility, type, product, and SKU.
The Sales navigation menu contains an Orders link that opens the order grid.
The Orders grid supports keyword search and filters, can be sorted by purchase date (descending by default), displays purchase date and status, and provides a View link for each order.
An order detail page provides a Cancel action; using it opens a confirmation dialog, and confirming displays a cancellation success message and removes the Cancel action from the page.

The Sales Orders Report is available under Reports > Sales > Orders. Its filters include Order Created or Order Updated, a Day, Month, or Year interval, date bounds, order status, empty rows, and actual values.
Clicking Show Report applies the selected Orders Report filters and displays interval-level order and sales metrics with a total row.
The Orders Report can be exported as CSV or Excel XML.
